limitations: Private synthetic fixture data, local paths and command stderr are intentionally excluded.
Performance certificates replay the original data-backed measurements; these tests do not rerun private benchmarks or models.
scope: Boundary-test evidence for the public replay CLI. The unchanged real snapshot contains 77 pools; every ready97/388 or tampered case is an explicitly synthetic fixture. These fixtures are not experimental samples and are not adopted results. Final real 97-pool adoption requires its separate actual-data replay.
verified_boundaries: Duplicate slots, forged readiness, incomplete cohorts and identity drift are rejected.
Wrong baseline hashes, changed retained rows and changed official row order are rejected.
Source selection accepts either the original 18 columns or the identical projection from the 21-column rescored source table.
Source model/backend/URL, configuration hash, result size, graph status/protocol, source kind and rerun reason are checked against the scoring package and status inventory.
Normal missing answers retain None in strict metrics and the specified Gap0 treatment.
Pending replay does not export formal tables and archives previously derived scalar and source tables.
Source artifacts and replay code cannot be overwritten by output paths.
